# 2 Clement — Chapter 17 (PNEUMA Dynamic)

**Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 2 Clement 17
**Agent:** PNEUMA (Dynamic)
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

1. So let us repent with all our hearts, so that none of us is lost on the way. We have been commanded to pull people away from idols and teach them. How much more, then, are we responsible for people who already know God — making sure they are not lost?
2. Let us help one another. Let us bring back those who have gone astray. Let us save everyone we can — warning each other, calling each other back.
3. And let's not just look like believers while we are here listening to the elders. When we go home, let us remember the Lord's commands. Let's not let the world's desires pull us back. Let's come here more often and work at growing in the Lord's commands.
4. If we are all united in this, we will be gathered into life together. The Lord said: "I am coming to gather all nations, tribes, and tongues." He is speaking of the day of his coming, when he arrives to repay everyone according to their deeds.
5. When unbelievers see his glory and power, they will be dumbstruck. They will see the kingdom of this world handed over to Jesus, and they will cry out: "We are destroyed — that was you all along, and we didn't know it, we didn't believe it, we didn't listen to the elders who were telling us how to be saved." Their worm will not die, their fire will not be quenched, and they will be a public spectacle.
6. That is the day of judgment — the day when those who have turned away from God's commands and twisted the teaching of Jesus will see his great power and be condemned.
7. But the righteous — those who did good, who endured suffering, who gave up the pleasures their bodies craved — will watch those who rejected Jesus in word and deed suffering terrible punishment in fire that never goes out, and they will give praise to God: "There is hope for the one who served God with their whole heart."
